questions.question: A small randomized phase 1 trial evaluated a personalized viral-based cancer vaccine for patients with resected head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC). What was the finding regarding recurrence at 2 years?

options.text: Recurrence was 19% in the vaccination arm and 0% in the standard arm
Recurrence was 0% in the vaccination arm and 19% in the standard arm
There was no difference in recurrence rates
Vaccination increased the rate of distant metastasis

questions.rationale: With a median follow up just over 2 years, the rate of recurrence was 0% in the vaccination arm and 19% in the standard arm.

questions.question: The MATTERHORN trial randomized patients with resectable gastric or EG junction adenocarcinoma to perioperative FLOT with or without durvalumab. What was the impact on pathologic complete response (pCR)?

options.text: pCR rates were identical between arms
pCR was significantly improved with durvalumab (19% vs 7%)
pCR was lower with durvalumab due to toxicity-related delays
pCR was improved only in PD-L1 high tumors

questions.rationale: The addition of durvalumab significantly improved the pCR rate to 19.2% versus 7.2% with FLOT alone.

questions.question: A randomized trial evaluated the traditional Chinese medicine formulation Biyan Qingdu Granula (BQG) in patients receiving radiation for nasopharyngeal carcinoma. What was the observed benefit?

options.text: It significantly reduced severe nasopharyngeal secretions and mucositis

questions.rationale: BQG was associated with a significantly lower rate of severe nasopharyngeal secretions (12.4% v 20%) and grade 3+ oral mucositis (12.3% v 22.4%).

questions.question: RTOG 1112 randomized patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma to sorafenib alone or SBRT followed by sorafenib. What was the impact on overall survival?

options.text: SBRT significantly worsened overall survival due to toxicity
SBRT improved median overall survival from 12.3 to 15.8 months
There was no difference in survival or progression-free survival
SBRT improved survival only in patients without vascular invasion

questions.rationale: Median overall survival was 15.8 months with SBRT and sorafenib compared to 12.3 months with sorafenib alone (HR 0.77, P=.06), and SBRT was significantly associated with OS on multivariable analysis.

questions.question: A single-arm phase 2 study evaluated the omission of surgery in patients with cT1-2N0-1 breast cancer who had a biopsy-confirmed pathologic complete response (pCR) after neoadjuvant therapy. What was the 5-year ipsilateral breast tumor recurrence rate?
questions.rationale: At 5 years, the ipsilateral breast tumor recurrence was a whopping 0% in patients who omitted surgery after biopsy-confirmed pCR.

questions.question: A study of SMART (Stereotactic MRI-guided Adaptive Radiotherapy) for abdominal oligometastases employed a workflow to account for daily variations in OARs. What were the 2-year toxicity outcomes?

options.text: Toxicity was high, leading to discontinuation of the protocol

questions.rationale: The two-year late grade 3+ toxicity rate was only 2% using the SMART protocol.
questions.citations: Akdemir, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A study using explainable AI identified dental calculus index as a risk factor for radiation-induced oral mucositis in nasopharyngeal carcinoma. What was the effect of a dental cleaning intervention?

options.text: It had no effect on mucositis rates
It significantly increased mucositis due to gum irritation
It reduced the rate of severe oral mucositis to 8.1%
It only helped in patients with low baseline plaque

questions.rationale: In the intervention group receiving professional cleaning, the rate of severe oral mucositis was 8.1%, lower than the 39.1% seen in the retrospective cohort.

questions.question: A retrospective study compared outcomes of esophagectomy following chemo-immunotherapy versus standard chemoradiation. What was the finding regarding 2-year disease-free survival?

options.text: Chemo-immunotherapy resulted in higher perioperative mortality

questions.rationale: Those in the chemoimmunotherapy cohort had higher 2-years disease-free (74% v 63%) survival compared to standard chemoradiation.

questions.question: A trial emulation study compared accelerated partial breast irradiation (APBI) modalities. Which modality was associated with a significantly higher risk of recurrence compared to photon therapy?
questions.rationale: The risk of recurrence was significantly higher with brachytherapy than with photon therapy (HR 7.64 for tumors >1cm).

questions.question: A review of aspirin's anticancer effects highlights a mechanism involving platelets. How does aspirin reportedly prevent metastasis?

options.text: By inducing direct tumor cell apoptosis
By preventing platelet-mediated immune suppression via TXA2 inhibition
By reducing systemic inflammation markers only

questions.rationale: Aspirin irreversibly inhibits platelet COX-1, shutting down thromboxane A2 (TXA2) production, which restores T cell-mediated micrometastasis elimination.

questions.question: Updated ASTRO guidelines for glioblastoma (GBM) recommend what fractionation schedule for elderly/poor performance status patients?
questions.rationale: Performance status continues to dictate fractionation shema: conventional versus hypofractionation, with hypofractionation being an option for those with poorer status.

questions.question: A prospective trial offered prophylactic contralateral breast irradiation to BRCA carriers receiving adjuvant RT. What was the 10-year outcome regarding contralateral breast cancer risk?

options.text: No significant difference in risk at 10 years
Benefit was seen only in BRCA2 carriers

questions.rationale: At 10 years there was no significant difference in the rate of contralateral breast cancer (13.8% v 18.3%, P=.24), although median time to development was delayed.

questions.question: A meta-analysis of 15 prospective trials evaluated local therapy for oligometastases. What was the impact on overall survival?

options.text: Worse overall survival due to toxicity

questions.rationale: Local therapy for oligometastases slashes progression-free (HR 0.48) and overall (HR 0.60) survival events.

questions.question: In the PEACE-3 trial, the addition of radium-223 to enzalutamide was initially associated with increased fractures. What intervention significantly reduced this risk?

options.text: Mandating the use of bone protecting agents

questions.rationale: The rate of fractures at 1 year significantly decreased when bone protecting agents were administered (2.6% v 15.6%).

questions.question: A review of pancreas cancer contouring suggests that locoregional failure is often driven by what pattern of spread?
questions.rationale: Extra-pancreatic perineural invasion (PNI) is nearly universal and a major driver of locoregional failure, often more so than lymph nodes.

questions.question: A randomized phase 2 trial used PSMA-PET to guide salvage radiation for prostate cancer. What was the outcome of PSMA-guided dose intensification?

options.text: Improved failure-free survival without increased toxicity
Improved survival but higher GI toxicity
No difference compared to standard salvage

questions.rationale: PSMA-guided dose intensification significantly improved failure free survival and eugonadal failure free survival without an increase in toxicity.

questions.question: Long-term outcomes from the ECOG-ACRIN E3311 trial for HPV+ oropharyngeal cancer evaluated de-escalated adjuvant radiation (50 Gy). What was observed regarding recurrence in the arm that received no adjuvant RT (Arm A)?

options.text: Multiple late recurrences, all in node-positive patients
Survival was superior to the 50 Gy arm

questions.rationale: There were 3 additional late recurrences in Arm A (the no RT arm), and all were in patients with a positive node (14.8% recurrence in N1 patients).

questions.question: The SANO trial compared active surveillance to standard esophagectomy for patients with a complete response to neoadjuvant chemoradiation. What was the 2-year overall survival outcome?

options.text: Surveillance led to higher distant metastasis rates
Surgery had better quality of life at 6 months

questions.rationale: Intention-to-treat analysis reports 2 year overall survival rates of 75% after surveillance and 70% after surgery, meeting non-inferiority thresholds.

questions.question: A small prospective trial treated patients with tumors involving the heart using MR-guided radiation. What was the rate of local recurrence free survival at 2 years?
questions.rationale: At 2 years, local recurrence free survival was 71.4%.
questions.citations: Zheng, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: Updated ASTRO guidelines for rectal cancer recommend what radiation approach for stage II-III disease?

options.text: Neoadjuvant long-course chemoradiation or short-course radiation

questions.rationale: Neoadjuvant radiation in sequence with neoadjuvant chemotherapy was strongly recommended for all patients with stage II-III disease.

questions.question: A retrospective study evaluated the benefit of boosting rectal cancer radiation dose to 56-60 Gy compared to 50 Gy. What was the finding regarding pathologic complete response (pCR)?

options.text: pCR increased from 17% to 27% with the boost
pCR improved only for T2 tumors

questions.rationale: Those who received a boost dose of 56-60 Gy achieved a significantly higher rate of pathologic complete response (27% versus 17%).

questions.question: A randomized trial evaluated oxybutynin for hot flashes in men on ADT. What was the effect on hot flash scores?

options.text: Significant reduction in hot flash scores

questions.rationale: Those who took oxybutynin saw a significantly greater reduction in hot flash scores (9.94-13.95 vs 4.85 for placebo).

questions.question: The MARIPOSA trial compared amivantamab plus lazertinib versus osimertinib for first-line EGFR-mutated NSCLC. What was the overall survival outcome?

options.text: The combination significantly improved overall survival (HR 0.75)
The combination was too toxic to assess survival

questions.rationale: The combo significantly extended overall survival with a 25% relative reduction in death (HR 0.75).

questions.question: A retrospective study of spine SBRT for prostate cancer compared different target volume approaches (SIB vs GTV-only vs compartment). Which approach had the best progression-free survival?
questions.rationale: The SIB approach was associated with the best outcomes with a PFS of 85.7% at 1 year compared to 81.2% and 45.5% with other approaches.

questions.question: A study of retroperitoneal radiation found that exceeding what bowel constraint was associated with increased toxicity?

options.text: No constraint was associated with toxicity

questions.rationale: Exceeding bowel V45 >195cc was still associated with an increased risk of toxicity.

questions.question: The DIPPER trial evaluated adjuvant camrelizumab (PD-1 inhibitor) after definitive chemoradiation for high-risk nasopharyngeal carcinoma. What was the impact on recurrence-free survival?
questions.rationale: Recurrence-free survival was significantly improved with camrelizumab from 77% to 87% at 3 years.

questions.question: A study of LINAC electricity consumption compared single-energy ring-gantry (Halcyon) versus multi-energy C-arm LINACs. What was the finding?

options.text: Ring-gantry LINACs consumed significantly less power
Power consumption depended only on beam-on time

questions.rationale: A single-energy, ring-gantry LINAC (Halcyon) had significantly less power consumption than a multi-energy C-arm LINAC.

questions.question: The RAVENS trial evaluated the addition of Radium-223 to SBRT for oligometastatic prostate cancer. What was the effect on progression-free survival (PFS)?

options.text: No significant improvement in median PFS
Worse PFS in the Radium-223 arm
Improved PFS only in bone-only disease

questions.rationale: The addition of Radium-223 did not significantly improve the primary endpoint of median PFS (10.5 v 11.8 months).

questions.question: A study used deep learning to create an imaging risk score for p16+ oropharyngeal cancer. For which risk group did concurrent chemotherapy improve disease-free survival?
questions.rationale: Receipt of concurrent chemo significantly improved disease-free survival for the high-risk cohort with no discernible benefit seen in the low-risk cohort.

questions.question: A Swedish registry study evaluated adding concurrent cisplatin to radiation for cT1-2 oropharyngeal cancer. Which subgroup showed a benefit?
questions.rationale: The only significant advantage was for patients younger than 70 with multiple ipsilateral nodes (i.e., N2b per p16-negative staging).
questions.citations: Adrian, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A randomized trial compared preoperative vs postoperative SRS for resected brain metastases. What was the outcome regarding local recurrence and leptomeningeal disease?

options.text: Postoperative SRS had lower recurrence rates
Preoperative SRS had significantly lower composite failure rates (12% vs 20%)
Leptomeningeal disease was higher with preoperative SRS

questions.rationale: The composite endpoint of local failure, nodular leptomeningeal disease, or grade 2+ radionecrosis was significantly lower in the preop group (12% v 20%).
questions.citations: Perlow, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A retrospective study of reirradiation for locoregionally recurrent NSCLC found what factor associated with better outcomes?
questions.rationale: Those who received immunotherapy had superior locoregional control and OS.

questions.question: A large study evaluated magnesium infusions during cisplatin therapy. What was the effect on acute kidney injury (AKI)?

options.text: Halved the rate of AKI (2.7% vs 5.3%)

questions.rationale: Rates of subsequent AKI were halved in the magnesium cohort (2.7%) versus others (5.3%).

questions.question: A study comparing flattening filter-free (FFF) vs flattened beams for lung SBRT found what regarding clinical outcomes?

options.text: No detriment to efficacy or toxicity with FFF

questions.rationale: There was no detriment to excellent rates of long term efficacy and toxicity with FFF techniques.

questions.question: The COMET trial compared active surveillance to standard care for low-risk DCIS. What was the 2-year invasive cancer detection rate?
questions.rationale: The primary endpoint of detection of ipsilateral invasive cancer within two years was 5.9% in the surgery group versus 4.2% in the active surveillance group.

questions.question: A study of PSMA-PET for prostate cancer evaluated its prognostic value based on PSMA response. What predicted the best outcomes?

options.text: Complete metabolic response in lymph nodes
Complete response in the primary tumor only

questions.rationale: Nodal complete response best delineated outcomes at 5 years—DMFS 87% vs 43%.
questions.citations: Onal, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A randomized trial evaluated palliative radiation with or without RFA/PVA for painful spine metastases. What was the result?

options.text: Combination therapy significantly improved pain control
No difference in pain control at 3 months

questions.rationale: The primary endpoint of pain control at 3 months was similar with or without RFA/PVA (48% v 50%).

questions.question: A meta-analysis of SRS margins for brain metastases found what regarding local control and necrosis?

options.text: No significant difference in local control or necrosis with or without margins
No margins resulted in high failure rates

questions.rationale: There was no significant difference in local control or the pooled rate of radiographic radionecrosis with or without a margin.

questions.question: The MANTLE trial evaluated manual therapy for late dysphagia after head and neck radiation. What was the finding?

options.text: Improved range of motion and symptoms but unclear swallowing benefit

questions.rationale: Large improvements were seen in range of motion and symptoms, but improvement in swallowing as measured by MDADI scores was less clear.
questions.citations: McMillan, JAMA Otolaryngol Head Neck Surg 2025

questions.question: A prospective study of palliative radiation delivered within a month of immunotherapy found what regarding grade 3+ toxicity?
questions.rationale: There was no associated grade 3+ toxicity reported.

questions.question: International consensus guidelines for renal cell carcinoma (RCC) SABR target delineation recommend including which structures in the target volume?
questions.rationale: Consensus recommendation was to always include tumor thrombus and ablation cavities in the target volume.
questions.citations: Dhar, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2026

questions.question: An analysis of the HILUS trial for ultracentral lung SBRT identified which factors as predictors of grade 5 hemorrhage?

options.text: High bronchial dose (D0.31cc) and bronchial tumor compression

questions.rationale: The two factors that best predicted grade 5 hemorrhage risk were near maximum dose (D0.31cc) and bronchial tumor compression.
questions.citations: Karlsson, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2026

questions.question: The PACIFIC-2 trial evaluated concurrent durvalumab with chemoradiation for stage III NSCLC. What was the outcome?

options.text: No improvement in PFS or OS compared to sequential durvalumab
Improved survival in PD-L1 negative patients

questions.rationale: Adding durvalumab at day 1 did not significantly improve the primary endpoint of PFS (13.8 v 9.4 months) or OS compared to standard care.

questions.question: Updated guidelines for postmastectomy radiation therapy (PMRT) recommend what fractionation scheme as the standard?
questions.rationale: Moderate hypofractionation (read: 15-16 fractions) is now officially preferred for virtually all scenarios.

questions.question: ESTRO guidelines for CTV delineation in post-op oral cavity cancer recommend what margin around the surrogate GTV/tumor bed?
questions.rationale: They recommend a 10 mm margin around the surrogate GTV.

questions.question: The CYBER-SPACE trial compared MPRAGE vs SPACE MRI sequences for brain metastasis planning. Did the more sensitive SPACE sequence reduce the need for salvage whole brain radiation?

options.text: No, there was no significant difference
SPACE increased the need for WBRT

questions.rationale: Using the SPACE sequence did not significantly improve the rate of WBRT-free survival at 12 months.

questions.question: A prospective study of hypofractionated breast radiation (26 Gy in 5 fractions) in Ireland reported what toxicity outcomes?

options.text: 5 of 6 women had no to minimal toxicity

questions.rationale: 5 of 6 women have no to minimal toxicity at any time point.

questions.question: NRG BN007 compared temozolomide vs ipilimumab/nivolumab with radiation for MGMT-unmethylated GBM. What was the result?

options.text: Ipi/nivo did not improve PFS or OS compared to TMZ
Ipi/nivo improved OS but not PFS

questions.rationale: Ipi/nivo did not significantly improve median PFS compared to standard TMZ (7.7 v 8.5 months). Likewise, there was no difference in OS.

questions.question: A study evaluating extended vs limited pelvic lymph node dissection during prostatectomy found what impact on metastasis-free survival?

options.text: Extended dissection significantly improved metastasis-free survival at 10 years
Extended dissection only improved biochemical control

questions.rationale: The metastasis-free survival at 10 years was 88% after extended versus 85% after limited dissection (HR 0.75 for distant metastasis).

questions.question: The NIVOPOSTOP trial randomized patients with high-risk resected HNSCC to adjuvant chemoradiation with or without nivolumab. What was the DFS outcome?

options.text: Significantly improved DFS with nivolumab (63% vs 53%)
Improved DFS only in p16+ patients

questions.rationale: Disease-free survival at 3 years was 53% with chemoradiation alone versus 63% with the addition of nivo.

questions.question: The ATOMIC trial evaluated adjuvant atezolizumab plus FOLFOX for stage III dMMR colon cancer. What was the 3-year disease-free survival (DFS) result?

options.text: Atezolizumab was inferior to chemo alone
Benefit only in stage II disease

questions.rationale: The primary endpoint of disease-free survival was at 3 years 77% with chemo and 86% with chemoimmunotherapy (HR 0.50).

questions.question: A dosimetric analysis of consolidative mediastinal radiation for Hodgkin lymphoma found what estimated lifetime risk of secondary breast cancer?
questions.rationale: Estimated mean lifetime attributable risk of secondary breast cancer was 2.92%.

questions.question: RTOG 0920 evaluated adding cetuximab to adjuvant radiation for intermediate-risk HNSCC. What was the effect on disease-free survival (DFS)?
questions.rationale: There was a significant improvement in DFS. At 3 years, the rate of locoregional failure was lower with the addition of cetuximab (14.7% v 20.2%).

questions.question: A large retrospective study evaluated outcomes for pancreatic cancer patients who received adjuvant chemotherapy after neoadjuvant FOLFIRINOX and resection. What was the finding?

options.text: Adjuvant chemo was associated with prolonged survival (HR 0.57)
Benefit was seen only in ypN0 patients

questions.rationale: Post-operative chemo was clearly associated with prolonged survival (HR 0.57).

questions.question: A dosimetric analysis of CyberKnife vs LINAC-based prostate SBRT plans from PACE-B found what regarding urethral dose?

options.text: CyberKnife plans had worse urethral dosimetry

questions.rationale: CyberKnife plans actually revealed worse urethral dosimetry, suggesting clinical toxicity differences might be due to motion management.
questions.citations: Ratnakumaran, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A trial comparing a 'sandwich' approach (induction chemo -> RT -> adjuvant chemo) vs concurrent chemoradiation for nasopharyngeal carcinoma found what outcome?

options.text: Sandwich approach was non-inferior with less toxicity during RT
Concurrent CRT was superior in survival
Sandwich approach had higher mucositis rates

questions.rationale: The sandwich approach was deemed noninferior (3yr FFS 83.7% v 79.5%) and had significantly less toxicity during RT.

questions.question: A trial of mediastinal nodal dissection for low-risk stage I ground glass lung adenocarcinoma was terminated early. Why?

options.text: Life-threatening complications in the dissection arm
High rate of nodal positivity in the observation arm

questions.rationale: The trial was terminated due to two life-threatening complications in the nodal dissection arm (chylothorax and SVC injury).

questions.question: A retrospective study evaluated if continuing androgen receptor pathway inhibitors (ARPI) during Lu177-PSMA therapy affects response. What was found?

options.text: Roughly half achieved PSA response regardless of continuing ARPI

questions.rationale: Roughly half of men achieve a ≥50% reduction in PSA whether continuing ARPI (n=106) or not (150).

questions.question: The IMvigor011 trial used ctDNA to guide adjuvant atezolizumab in bladder cancer. What was the outcome for ctDNA-positive patients treated with atezolizumab?

options.text: Benefit only in PD-L1 high tumors

questions.rationale: Among ctDNA-positive patients, the addition of early atezolizumab doubled median disease-free survival from 5 to 10 months (HR 0.64).

questions.question: PORTEC 4a randomized high-intermediate risk endometrial cancer to molecular-guided vs standard vaginal brachytherapy. What was the 5-year vaginal recurrence rate in the molecular arm?
questions.rationale: The rate of vaginal recurrence was deemed non-inferior with molecular-based adjuvant therapy, however the rate at 5 years was 4.5% compared to 1.6% with VBT.

questions.question: A phase 2 trial added atezolizumab to neoadjuvant trastuzumab/chemo for HER2+ gastric cancer. What was the impact on pCR?
questions.rationale: The pathologic complete response rate was dramatically improved from 14% without to 38% with the addition of atezo.

questions.question: A trial of 'low-tech' telephone QOL monitoring for elderly cancer patients found what impact on healthcare utilization?

options.text: Increased ED visits due to anxiety

questions.rationale: This yielded significantly less emergency department visits (48% → 31%) and halved hospitalizations (40% → 19%).

questions.question: A retrospective study of ultra-hypofractionated radiation (6 Gy x 5) for melanoma found what surgical revision rate?
questions.rationale: A retrospective look outcomes following 6 Gy x 5 mostly electron radiation reports a surgical revision rate of only 5%.

questions.question: A planning study of lung SBRT using a non-coplanar VMAT optimization found what benefit?

options.text: Better conformity and lower OAR dose

questions.rationale: The re-optimized plans had significantly lower conformity indices (better conformity) and significantly better sparing of the chest wall and lungs.

questions.question: A study of ypN0i+ (isolated tumor cells) breast cancer patients found what rate of axillary recurrence at 3 years?
questions.rationale: Reported a 2% axillary recurrence rate at 3 years regardless of receipt of completion axillary dissection.

questions.question: A trial of bone SBRT found what 1-year local control rate?
questions.rationale: At 1 year, local control was 93.1%.
questions.citations: Spindler, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A Chinese phase 2 trial added atezolizumab to trastuzumab chemo for HER2+ gastric cancer. What was the pCR rate with atezolizumab?
questions.rationale: The primary endpoint of pathologic complete response rate was dramatically improved from 14% without to 38% with the addition of atezo.

questions.question: A study described 'two-stage' eye plaque brachytherapy for large uveal melanomas. What was the benefit?
questions.rationale: Two treatments of 45 Gy is delivered to 13 patients with especially large tumors to successfully avoid enucleation.

questions.question: 5-year results from the OLIGOPELVIS trial of salvage pelvic nodal radiation for prostate cancer showed what outcomes?

options.text: One-third remained free of biochemical recurrence
Survival was inferior to ADT alone

questions.rationale: Five-year outcomes demonstrate one-third of patients remain without biochemical recurrence at five years.

questions.question: A cohort study of smoking cessation in cancer patients found what survival benefit?

options.text: Improved survival at 5 and 10 years for abstainers
Benefit only for lung cancer patients
Worse survival due to withdrawal stress

questions.rationale: Patients who were abstinent at 3 months after intervention had significantly better survival at 5 (65% v 61%) and 10 years (77% v 73%).

questions.question: The SUPREMO trial randomized intermediate-risk breast cancer patients to chest wall radiation or not after mastectomy. What was the 10-year overall survival result?

options.text: No significant difference in overall survival
Radiation improved survival only in N1 patients

questions.rationale: The primary endpoint of overall survival at ten years with or without radiation was virtually identical at roughly 82%.

questions.question: An intra-patient randomized trial used a transparent film dressing during breast radiation. What was the effect on dermatitis?

options.text: No grade 2+ dermatitis on the film side vs 40% on unprotected side

questions.rationale: At treatment’s end, none of the film-protected halves developed CTCAE grade ≥2 dermatitis, versus ~40% of the unprotected halves.
questions.citations: Harish, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: The SOHO-01 trial evaluated sevabertinib for HER2-mutated NSCLC. What did it show?

options.text: High toxicity leading to trial closure

questions.rationale: The early-phase SOHO-01 trial suggests the HER2/EGFR-TKI sevabertinib produces meaningful, durable responses.

questions.question: A phase 2 trial compared concurrent vs sequential pembrolizumab with chemoradiation for HNSCC. Which approach was superior?

options.text: Sequential was superior in locoregional control and PFS

questions.rationale: The sequential arm had significantly better locoregional control (96% v 64%) and numerically better PFS (69% v 49%) and OS.

questions.question: A study of orbital inflammatory disease treated with 20 Gy in 10 fractions found what steroid-taper outcome?
questions.rationale: Ultimately 32 patients (56%) were able to taper off steroids completely.

questions.question: A study of incontinence after salvage prostate radiation (SAKK 09/10) found what effect of dose escalation (64 vs 70 Gy)?

options.text: Late incontinence was rare in both arms

questions.rationale: Dose escalation did not significantly impact the rates of post-treatment incontinence nor changes in continence over time.

questions.question: A cohort study evaluated ablative radiation for resectable pancreatic cancer in high-risk patients. What was the 1-year local control?
questions.rationale: Local control was 85.6% at 1 year and 79.2% at 2 years.

questions.question: A pilot study used palliative radiation as bridging therapy for CAR T cell therapy. What was the in-field response rate?
questions.rationale: 30% had an in-field complete response, and 60% had a partial response.
questions.citations: Ababneh, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A study of definitive radiation for anterior nasal cavity cancer found what 5-year local recurrence rate?
questions.rationale: At 5 years, the rate of local recurrence was 16%.

questions.question: A study of the HYPO-RT-PC trial cohort (ultra-hypo prostate RT) found what regarding 10-year GU/GI toxicity?

options.text: No difference in excess GU/GI interventions/hospitalizations compared to controls

questions.rationale: Found no difference in excess GU or GI interventions or hospitalizations at 10 years in patients who were enrolled in the HYPO-RT-PC trial.

questions.question: A comparison of adjuvant vs salvage radiation for grade 2 meningioma found what regarding toxicity?

options.text: Adjuvant radiation had significantly higher acute and late toxicity
No grade 3+ toxicity was observed in either group

questions.rationale: Adjuvant versus salvage radiation results in significantly higher rates of acute (90% versus 69%) and late (57% versus 33%) toxicity.

questions.question: A study of taste impairment after H&N radiation found what prevalence at 1 year?
questions.rationale: Taste impairment was reported by 19% at 12 months.

questions.question: A secondary analysis of the LUSTRE trial (SBRT vs hypofractionation for lung cancer) evaluated quality of life (QOL). What was the finding at 2 years?

options.text: QOL outcomes were similar between arms
QOL declined significantly in both arms

questions.rationale: By 24 months, all domains converged with small numerical advantages favoring hypofractionated radiation that did not reach clinically-meaningful thresholds.
questions.citations: Hou, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: The NO-CUT trial evaluated non-operative management for rectal cancer complete responders. What was the 30-month distant relapse-free survival?
questions.rationale: At 30 months, the primary endpoint of distant relapse free survival was excellent with nonoperative management (95%).

questions.question: A meta-analysis of prostate boost toxicity found what association with dose?

options.text: Logarithmic association between rectal/urethral max doses and toxicity
Linear association with mean dose only

questions.rationale: There were significant logarithmic associations between rectal and urethral maximum doses and reported acute GI and late GU toxicities, respectively.
questions.citations: Patel, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A planning study compared tangent-based IMRT vs VMAT for breast radiation. Which technique had better contralateral OAR sparing?
questions.rationale: IMRT plans had superior contralateral OAR dosimetry.

questions.question: A randomized trial compared rectal spacers vs no spacer in patients receiving chemoradiation and brachytherapy. Did spacers reduce toxicity?

options.text: Yes, significantly reduced late rectal toxicity
No significant difference in acute or chronic rectal toxicity
Reduced toxicity only in the acute setting

questions.rationale: The rates of acute (55.6% v 46.9%) and chronic (9.5% v 16.7%) rectal toxicity were similar between groups.
questions.citations: Wang, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: Long-term follow-up of NRG (GOG) 258 for endometrial cancer compared chemoradiation vs chemotherapy. What was the overall survival result?

options.text: Chemoradiation improved survival in stage III only

questions.rationale: There was no difference in overall survival outcomes between groups.

questions.question: A study of lung SBRT using abdominal compression found what regarding target margins?
questions.rationale: Only 53 fractions (8.7%) had shifts ≥5.0 mm... Ultimately the authors conclude 5-mm margins are sufficient.

questions.question: A case report described successful treatment of Rosai-Dorfman disease with radiation. What was the regimen?
questions.rationale: Details successful durable treatment of large-volume Rosai-Dorfman disease... with a hypofractionated course of 40 Gy in 15 fractions.

questions.question: The PEACE-3 trial evaluated adding radium-223 to enzalutamide for mCRPC. What was the impact on radiographic progression-free survival (rPFS)?
questions.rationale: The addition of radium-223 significantly prolonged the primary endpoint of median radiographic progression free survival (19.4 v 16.4 mo).

questions.question: A study of next-line therapy for NSCLC after chemo-IO found which regimen had the best outcomes?
questions.rationale: Second-line ICI as monotherapy or in combo with chemo appeared to produce longer disease-free intervals and survival.

questions.question: A retrospective study evaluated DPYD testing before 5-FU chemotherapy. What was the finding regarding treatment-related death?

options.text: Numerically less death with testing (0.18% vs 0.72%)

questions.rationale: Preemptive DPYD-gene alteration testing experienced numerically less treatment-related death (0.18%) than those who didn’t (0.72%).

questions.question: A review of reirradiation for locally recurrent rectal cancer recommends what fractionation for curative intent treatment of unresectable disease?
questions.rationale: The most robust data supports hyperfractionation with something like 1.2-1.5 Gy twice daily to 39-45 Gy (or ~50 Gy for unresectable).

questions.question: ESTRO/EANO guidelines for reirradiating glioblastoma recommend what dose for smaller targets?
questions.rationale: Preferred regimens of 27-30 Gy in 3-5 fractions for smaller targets.

questions.question: The CONKO-007 trial evaluated adding chemoradiation to induction chemotherapy for unresectable pancreatic cancer. What was the effect on R0 resection rate?

options.text: Significantly increased R0 rate among those who had surgery

questions.rationale: When looking at those who actually had surgery, CRT did significantly increase the R0 resection rate (69.4% v 50%).

questions.question: A study of peer review in stereotactic radiation found what association with physician volume?

options.text: Higher volume physicians had more plan revisions
Lower volume physicians had higher plan revision rates (28.5% v 16.8%)
Volume was not associated with revisions
Mid-career physicians had the highest revision rates

questions.rationale: Plan revision rates were higher for lower volume physicians with 10 or fewer stereotactic cases in the prior 3 months (28.5% v 16.8%).

questions.question: The NARLAL2 trial evaluated PET-guided dose escalation for locally advanced NSCLC. Did dose escalation increase acute toxicity?

options.text: No, no significant difference in acute grade 2+ toxicity

questions.rationale: Dose escalation did not significantly increase grade 2 or grade 3 esophagitis or pneumonitis.

questions.question: The HN004 trial compared durvalumab vs cetuximab with radiation for cisplatin-ineligible HNSCC. What was the outcome?

options.text: Cetuximab was superior (PFS 55% vs 31% in p16-)
Durvalumab had less toxicity but equal efficacy

questions.rationale: Among p16 negative patients, PFS at 2 years was 31.4% with durvalumab versus 55.4% with cetuximab.

questions.question: A randomized trial compared stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) vs hippocampal-avoidance whole brain radiation (HA-WBRT) for 5-20 brain metastases. What was the finding regarding symptom severity?

options.text: SRS resulted in decreased symptom severity compared to HA-WBRT

questions.rationale: In the six months following SRS, symptom severity decreased, while it increased following HA-WBRT, producing a significant difference.

questions.question: The SPRING-01 phase 2 trial evaluated the addition of sintilimab to total neoadjuvant therapy (short course RT + CAPOX) for high-risk locally advanced rectal cancer. What was the impact on pathologic complete response (pCR)?

options.text: pCR was significantly improved with sintilimab (59.2% vs 32.7%)
pCR was lower with sintilimab due to toxicity
Sintilimab improved pCR only in dMMR tumors

questions.rationale: The pCR rate was 59.2% with the addition of sintilimab versus 32.7% without.

questions.question: The EXTEND basket trial evaluated the addition of metastasis-directed therapy (MDT) to standard care for oligometastatic cancer. Which histology-specific baskets showed an improvement in progression-free survival with MDT?
questions.rationale: The pancreas, prostate, and 'other' baskets saw improved PFS with MDT, but the breast and renal baskets did not.

questions.question: NRG-BN001 was a randomized phase 2 trial comparing photon versus proton dose-escalated radiation (75 Gy) for glioblastoma. What was the finding regarding overall survival?

options.text: Protons were associated with improved median survival (22.8 vs 22 months)

questions.rationale: Proton SIB to 75 Gy eeked out an advantage in median survival (22 → 22.8 months, HR 0.81) and survival at 3 years (25% → 30%).

questions.question: The METIS phase 3 trial evaluated tumor treating fields (TTFields) after stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) for 1-10 brain metastases from NSCLC. What was the primary outcome?

options.text: Worse quality of life without efficacy benefit

questions.rationale: Follow-on tumor treating fields prolonged time to intracranial progression (HR 0.72) with consistent separation at 6, 12, and 24 months.

questions.question: The THORA phase 2 trial compared 60 Gy in 40 twice-daily fractions versus 45 Gy in 30 twice-daily fractions for limited stage small cell lung cancer. What was the impact on survival?

options.text: Median overall survival was nearly doubled with 60 Gy
60 Gy was toxic and reduced survival
Improved survival only in patients who did not receive PCI

questions.rationale: Median OS was nearly doubled from 22.5 to 43.5 months with the dose-escalated regimen.

questions.question: A phase 2 trial evaluated neoadjuvant pembrolizumab for locoregionally advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. Among patients with a complete pathologic or clinical response (cCR/pCR), what was the recurrence rate without further surgery or radiation?
questions.rationale: No patients with a cCR or pCR had recurrence. Among those with a cCR or pCR, the rate of EFS at 12 months was 94%.

questions.question: The DIPLOMA trial compared minimally-invasive versus open distal pancreatectomy for cancer. What was the finding regarding R0 resection rates?

options.text: Open surgery had superior R0 rates
Minimally-invasive surgery was non-inferior for R0 resection
Minimally-invasive surgery had unacceptably low R0 rates
R0 rates depended on tumor size

questions.rationale: The minimal approach resulted in non-inferior rates of R0 resection (73% versus 69%, respectively).

questions.question: The UPGRADE-RT trial compared standard (50 Gy) versus de-escalated (43 Gy) elective nodal irradiation for head and neck cancer. What was the impact on swallowing function?

options.text: De-escalation significantly improved swallowing at 1 year
No significant difference in swallowing at 1 year
Standard dose had better swallowing outcomes
De-escalation improved swallowing only in N0 patients

questions.rationale: The primary outcome of physician-scoring of the ability to eat 10 different food categories at one year after treatment was virtually identical either way.
questions.citations: van den Bosch, J Clin Oncol 2025

questions.question: A phase 2 trial evaluated radiation alone (MDT) for oligometastatic renal cell carcinoma (RCC). What was the median systemic therapy-free survival?

options.text: MDT did not delay systemic therapy

questions.rationale: The median systemic therapy free survival was a whopping 34 months.

questions.question: A comparative analysis of IMRT vs 3D conformal radiation for locally advanced NSCLC in a statewide consortium found what regarding toxicity?

options.text: No significant difference in short-term grade 2+ toxicity

questions.rationale: There were no significant differences in the rates of grade 2+ or grade 3+ esophagitis or pneumonitis reported at 6 months.
questions.citations: Allen, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A phase 2 trial evaluated short-course radiation followed by FOLFOXIRI for rectal cancer organ preservation. What was the 2-year TME-free survival?
questions.rationale: In the overall study population, the rate of TME-free survival at 2 years was 26%.

questions.question: The GEMSTONE-303 trial evaluated the addition of sugemalimab (PD-L1 inhibitor) to chemotherapy for unresectable gastric cancer. What was the survival outcome?

options.text: Benefit only in PD-L1 negative tumors

questions.rationale: Median overall survival was improved from 13 to 16 months.

questions.question: Updated ASTRO guidelines for anal cancer state what regarding the use of IMRT?
questions.rationale: IMRT-based radiation with concurrent 5FU and mitomycin C remain standard.

questions.question: The DEPEND phase 2 trial evaluated de-escalated therapy for HPV-negative HNSCC responders to neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy. What proportion had >50% tumor reduction?
questions.rationale: Just over half of patients (53%) had a >50% reduction in tumor volume.

questions.question: A meta-analysis of ablative treatments for localized renal cell carcinoma found what local control rate for SBRT at 5 years?
questions.rationale: The rate of local control at 5 years was 95% for SBRT.

questions.question: An international consensus on radiographic extranodal extension (ENE) in head and neck cancer agreed on what definition?
questions.rationale: 'Indistinct' or 'irregular' nodal margins represent a hallmark of ENE.

questions.question: Long-term follow-up of a 15-year-old APBI dose escalation trial (32 vs 36 vs 40 Gy in 10 fractions) found what regarding adverse effects?

options.text: Higher dose was associated with more severe fibrosis and worse cosmesis
Lower dose had worse local control
40 Gy had the best cosmetic outcome

questions.rationale: Higher rates of severe fibrosis (40% v 58% v 67%) and more patient-rated fair or poor cosmesis (25% v 30% v 49%) were seen with higher doses.
questions.citations: Taghian, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2024

questions.question: A study of breast surface dose and toxicity found that an axilla surface D2cc >48 Gy was associated with what?
questions.rationale: Axilla surface D2cc >48 Gy was associated with a significantly higher risk of moist desquamation.
questions.citations: Salari, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A retrospective study used molecular profiling (IntegratedScore) to classify grade 1 meningiomas. What was observed for those with intermediate/high risk scores treated with subtotal resection?

options.text: Significantly lower progression-free survival (40%) compared to low risk
No recurrence regardless of resection extent

questions.rationale: Intermediate and high risk IntS was associated with lower PFS after STR (40% v 85.9%).

questions.question: An imaging review of prostate anatomy for SBRT planning found what regarding the internal pudendal artery (IPA)?

options.text: It is always adherent to the prostate
It is typically >2 cm from the prostate
It cannot be spared with SBRT
It receives full dose in most plans

questions.rationale: The median distance to the IPA was 2.3 cm.

questions.question: RACE-GB randomized patients with unresectable gallbladder cancer to consolidative chemoradiation vs observation after induction chemo. What was the survival outcome?

options.text: Median survival improved from 4 to 10 months
Improved survival only in node negative disease

questions.rationale: Overall survival from randomization was significantly improved from 4 months with observation to 10 months with the addition of consolidative chemoradiation.
questions.citations: Agrawal, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A multicenter study comparing standard vs reduced dose preoperative SRS for brain metastases found what regarding local recurrence?

options.text: No difference in local recurrence at 2 years
Dose did not matter, but size did

questions.rationale: At the 2 year mark, there were no differences in local recurrence (16% v 15%).

questions.question: A retrospective review of daily vs every-other-day (EOD) 5-fraction partial breast irradiation found what regarding toxicity?

options.text: Acute and late toxicity were similar between schedules

questions.rationale: Rates of acute breast dermatitis were, if anything, better with daily treatment... Rates of late toxicity were identical.

questions.question: A study of bowel dose constraints for 5-fraction prostate elective nodal irradiation found what association with toxicity?

options.text: No significant association between bowel dosimetry and toxicity
Large bowel dose predicted toxicity but not small bowel

questions.rationale: There was no significant association between bowel bag or bowel loop dosimetry and acute or late toxicity risk.
questions.citations: Ong, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A randomized trial compared proton versus involved-field photon craniospinal irradiation (CSI) for leptomeningeal disease. What was the survival result?

options.text: Proton CSI improved overall survival (11 vs 5 months)

questions.rationale: Proton CSI demonstrated improved overall survival (median 11 versus 5 months).

questions.question: A study comparing complications of post-mastectomy radiation (PMRT) with proton vs photon therapy in implant-based reconstruction found what?

options.text: Protons were associated with higher rates of contracture and implant loss
Photons had higher rates of explantation

questions.rationale: Proton therapy was associated with significantly higher rates of contracture (30% v 10%), implant loss (48% v 28%), explantation (32% v 16%), and overall reconstruction failure.
questions.citations: Naoum, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A randomized phase 3 trial compared IMPT vs IMRT for oropharyngeal cancer. What was the finding regarding toxicity?

options.text: IMPT significantly reduced grade 3+ dysphagia and xerostomia

questions.rationale: IMPT appeared to significantly reduce grade ≥3 dysphagia (34% vs 49%), xerostomia (33% vs 45%).

questions.question: A study of metastatic breast cancer patients found what pattern regarding brain metastases prevalence and lines of therapy?

options.text: Prevalence increased with each line of therapy
Only HER2+ patients developed brain mets

questions.rationale: The prevalence of brain metastases increases with each line of therapy for metastatic breast cancer.

questions.question: A study of grade 1 meningiomas proposed reclassifying tumors based on chromosomal alterations. Which alterations were associated with grade 2-like behavior?

options.text: Both loss of 1p and gain of 1q

questions.rationale: Grade 1 tumors with loss of chromosome 1p were on par with grade 2 tumors.

questions.question: A study of internal mammary node (IMN) recurrence in breast cancer found what factor associated with lower risk of recurrence?

options.text: Receipt of therapeutic IMN dose (>=40 Gy)

questions.rationale: The receipt of therapeutic IMN dose was associated with a significantly lower risk of IMN recurrence.
questions.citations: Nichol, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A study of AI-derived risk scores (AIRIS) for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma used what technique?
questions.rationale: This study created a prognostic score... through a process called retrieval augmented generation (RAG) enabled generative pretrained transformer (GPT).

questions.question: 10-year results of the UK IMPORT LOW trial for partial breast irradiation showed what regarding ipsilateral recurrence?

options.text: Partial breast RT had significantly higher recurrence
Partial breast RT recurrence rates were low and similar to whole breast RT (approx 3%)
Reduced dose whole breast RT failed

questions.rationale: At the 10 year landmark, the cumulative rates of ipsilateral breast tumor recurrence were 2.8% (whole breast), 1.9% (reduced dose), and 3.0% (partial breast).

questions.question: DESTINY-Breast09 evaluated first-line trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) + pertuzumab for metastatic HER2+ breast cancer. What was the PFS outcome?

options.text: T-DXd alone was superior to the combination

questions.rationale: T-DXd + pertuzumab delivered a median PFS of 41 months versus 27 months with THP.

questions.question: A Dutch study evaluated omission of completion axillary dissection in cN1 breast cancer patients with ypN0 after neoadjuvant therapy. What was the axillary recurrence rate?
questions.rationale: There was 1 (0.7%) axillary recurrence in the ypN0 cohort.

questions.question: MC1625 compared de-escalated adjuvant therapy (30 Gy + docetaxel) vs standard (60 Gy + cisplatin) for HPV+ oropharyngeal cancer. Which group had worse outcomes with de-escalation?
questions.rationale: This difference seemed to be mostly in the cohort with extranodal extension with a 2 year PFS of 81.1% with de-escalation versus 97.4% with standard therapy.

questions.question: The DUART phase 2 trial evaluated durvalumab sequential to radiation for locally-advanced NSCLC ineligible for chemo. What was the grade 3+ toxicity rate?
questions.rationale: The rate of grade 3+ toxicity clocked in at 10%.

questions.question: A validation study of the POLAR genomic signature for breast cancer found what regarding adjuvant radiation benefit?

options.text: RT reduced recurrence in high-risk patients but not low-risk
RT was only beneficial in low-risk patients
POLAR did not predict RT benefit

questions.rationale: Among low risk patients, there was no significant reduction... However, among high risk patients, adjuvant RT significantly reduced the risk.

questions.question: 10-year results from PORTEC-3 showed adjuvant chemoradiation improved survival most in which molecular subgroup?
questions.rationale: The latter group (p53abn) saw the most significant improvement in OS with the addition of chemotherapy (52.7% v 36.6%).

questions.question: A trial of parotid-sparing whole brain radiation found what dosimetric reduction?

options.text: Mean parotid dose reduced from 17 to 10 Gy

questions.rationale: Mean parotid dose was reduced from 17→ 10 Gy with reductions across all metrics.
questions.citations: Wang, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: The HYDRA meta-analysis of hypofractionated prostate radiation found what difference between isodose and dose-escalated hypofractionation?

options.text: No differences in toxicity or control

questions.rationale: They found a significant difference was increased rates of grade 2+ GI toxicity and decrements in bowel quality-of-life for dose-escalated HF.

questions.question: A study of post-radiation PSMA PET uptake found the optimal time to predict complete response was:
questions.rationale: Using receiver-operator curve analysis, the optimal time to predict complete response on PSMA PET was 8.6 months.

questions.question: A randomized trial comparing fluciclovine and PSMA PET for salvage prostate radiation found:

options.text: Fluciclovine detected more prostate fossa recurrences

questions.rationale: Gross disease was able to be boosted in 83% of fluciclovine-guided and 53% of PSMA-guided radiation plans, suggesting higher sensitivity of fluciclovine for fossa recurrences.

questions.question: A trial comparing FET-PET vs MRI for glioblastoma reirradiation target delineation found:
questions.rationale: The use of FET-PET did not significantly increase median PFS (4 v 4.9 months).

questions.question: A phase 2 trial added atezolizumab and tiragolumab to neoadjuvant chemoradiation for rectal cancer. What was the pCR rate compared to atezolizumab alone?

options.text: Both were inferior to historical control

questions.rationale: The pCR rate with atezo + tira was significantly higher than historical control (35.7% v 15%) whereas the pCR rate with atezo alone was not.

questions.question: A meta-analysis of deferred systemic therapy for metastatic renal cell carcinoma (RCC) found a 1-year systemic therapy-free survival of:
questions.rationale: Systemic therapy–free survival was 74% at 1 year.

questions.question: 9-year results from CheckMate 238 comparing adjuvant nivolumab vs ipilimumab for melanoma found:

options.text: Nivolumab improved recurrence-free survival but not overall survival

questions.rationale: Median recurrence-free survival remained substantially longer with nivolumab... Ultimately, there was no significant difference in the rate of melanoma death.

questions.question: The SPARC phase 2 trial evaluated focal simultaneous integrated boost (SIB) during prostate SBRT. What was the finding regarding GU toxicity?

options.text: Grade 2+ GU toxicity was 35% at 2 years
Toxicity was lower than standard SBRT

questions.rationale: At 2 years, the cumulative rate of grade 2+ GU adverse events was 35%... In PACE-B, the rate... was 18.3%.
questions.citations: Yasar, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2026

questions.question: Secondary analysis of the ENZA-p trial found what PSMA PET parameter predicted benefit from adding 177Lu-PSMA to enzalutamide?
questions.rationale: High TTV was... predictive of benefit from the addition of Pluvicto.

questions.question: A substudy of RTOG 1016 comparing cisplatin vs cetuximab with radiation for HPV+ oropharyngeal cancer found what regarding hearing loss?

options.text: Cisplatin caused significantly worse hearing loss
Hearing loss recovered in both arms

questions.rationale: Patient-reported hearing loss was significantly worse following cisplatin versus cetuximab.
questions.citations: Runge, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A study of elective pelvic nodal involvement in bladder cancer found that for T2-T3 high grade disease, 95% of nodal metastases were located where?
questions.rationale: Nearly all nodal disease (≥95%) in T2–T3 G3 patients remained below the iliac bifurcation.

questions.question: A retrospective study evaluated low-dose radiotherapy (LDRT) for hip arthrosis and greater trochanteric pain syndrome (GTPS). What factors were negatively associated with response?
questions.rationale: Older age and higher BMI were negatively associated with response rates (58% for hip arthrosis and 64% for GTPS).
questions.citations: Klepzig, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A secondary analysis of three NRG/RTOG trials evaluated treatment interruptions in head and neck radiation. For which group was the absolute reduction in disease control highest after a break?
questions.rationale: The stakes are highest for advanced-stage HPV-negative disease which saw a >10% absolute reduction in disease control after a treatment interruption.
questions.citations: Gharzai, JAMA Otolaryngol Head Neck Surg 2025

questions.question: A pooled analysis of two prospective cohorts compared robotic-assisted versus conventional laparoscopic surgery. What factor mediated the increased risk of postoperative pulmonary complications in the robotic group?
questions.rationale: Multivariable modeling pointed towards a clear culprit: duration of mechanical ventilation, full stop. Patients undergoing robotic cases had over double the ventilation time.

questions.question: An ESMO-ESTRO consensus statement on combining radiation with targeted therapies recommends what regarding VEGF inhibitors and multi-target TKIs?

options.text: Major adaptation is recommended across most sites
They are safe for ultracentral thoracic targets

questions.rationale: It was not so for the VEGF inhibitors and TKIs with major adaptation recommended across most sites. It was also recommended to not combine RT and VEGF inhibitors or TKIs for ultracentral targets.

questions.question: A phase 3 trial compared neoadjuvant chemoradiation vs upfront surgery for locally-advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Despite a 29% pCR rate with chemoradiation, what was the 5-year overall survival result?

options.text: Chemoradiation improved survival only in node negative patients

questions.rationale: Overall survival at 5 years was essentially identical—59% with NCRT versus 60% with upfront surgery.

questions.question: A retrospective study of SBRT for HNSCC lung metastases found what 3-fraction equivalent dose was required to achieve >95% local control at 2 years?
questions.rationale: A 3 fraction equivalent dose of 50 Gy had >95% local control at 2 years.

questions.question: A study described the creation of a low-cost, 3D-printed electron multileaf collimator (eMLC). How did it compare to Cerrobend?

options.text: It produced sharper field edges than Cerrobend
It could not block electrons above 6 MeV

questions.rationale: The device effectively blocked electron beams up to 15 MeV, showed no measurable leakage, and produced even sharper field edges than Cerrobend.

questions.question: The MATTERHORN trial randomized patients with resectable gastric/EG junction adenocarcinoma to perioperative FLOT with or without durvalumab. What was the impact on event-free survival (EFS)?

options.text: EFS benefit limited to PD-L1 high patients

questions.rationale: The addition of durvalumab significantly improved 2 year EFS from 67.4% v 58.5%.

questions.question: A randomized trial tested the traditional Chinese medicine Biyan Qingdu Granula (BQG) during nasopharyngeal carcinoma radiation. What specific toxicity was reduced?

options.text: Severe nasopharyngeal secretions and oral mucositis

questions.rationale: BQG was associated with a significantly lower rate of severe nasopharyngeal secretions (12.4% v 20%) and grade 3+ oral mucositis (12.3% v 22.4%).

questions.question: RTOG 1112 randomized patients with advanced HCC to sorafenib alone or SBRT followed by sorafenib. What was the impact on progression-free survival (PFS)?

options.text: Benefit only in patients with portal vein thrombosis

questions.rationale: PFS was significantly prolonged with SBRT from 5.5 to 9.0 months.

questions.question: A trial emulation compared APBI modalities for early-stage breast cancer. Which modality had a significantly higher risk of recurrence for tumors >1cm?
questions.rationale: Differences were most prominent among those with tumors >1cm where recurrence risk with significantly higher with brachytherapy than with photon therapy (HR 7.64).

questions.question: A review of aspirin's anticancer mechanism highlights its inhibition of platelet COX-1. How does this affect T cells?

options.text: It restores T cell-mediated micrometastasis elimination by reducing thromboxane A2
It has no effect on T cells

questions.rationale: Aspirin’s blunting of TXA2 restores T cell-mediated micrometastasis elimination.

questions.question: Updated ASTRO guidelines for glioblastoma recommend what regarding target margins?
questions.rationale: Table 5 summarizes target volumes including recommendations for the notorious 1-2 cm clinical target margins.

questions.question: A prospective trial of prophylactic contralateral breast irradiation in BRCA carriers found what impact on median time to contralateral cancer?
questions.rationale: The median time to development of a contralateral breast cancer was significantly longer after prophylactic RT (90 v 40 months).

questions.question: A meta-analysis of local therapy for oligometastases found significant benefits for which primary tumor types?

options.text: Prostate and non-small cell lung cancer

questions.rationale: Subgroup analyses demonstrated consistent significant benefits for prostate and non-small lung cancers but not breast cancers.

questions.question: In the PEACE-3 trial, what was the impact of mandated bone protecting agents (BPAs) on fracture risk in the radium-223 + enzalutamide arm?
questions.rationale: There were higher rates of fracture in both arms until BPAs were mandated–dropping... from 53.6% → 14.2% in the enzalutamide plus radium-223 arm.

questions.question: A review of pancreas cancer contouring recommends coverage of which elective pathways to improve locoregional control?
questions.rationale: Anatomically-informed elective coverage of perineural pathways (celiac, SMA, CHA plexi, etc.) could prove the key to improving locoregional control.

questions.question: A randomized phase 2 trial used PSMA-PET to guide salvage radiation. What dose was used for PSMA-avid nodes?
questions.rationale: PSMA-avid sites of disease could receive an EQD2 of 66 Gy to nodes and 77 Gy to the prostate fossa.

questions.question: In the E3311 trial, omitting adjuvant radiation (Arm A) for p16+ oropharyngeal cancer resulted in 0% recurrence for N0 patients. What was the recurrence rate for N1 patients in this arm?
questions.rationale: Within Arm A, 0% of N0 patients recurred compared to 14.8% of N1 patients.

questions.question: The SANO trial compared active surveillance to surgery for esophageal cancer complete responders. What was the rate of distant metastasis at 30 months in the surveillance arm?
questions.rationale: The rate of distant metastasis at 30 months was 43% with surveillance and 34% with surgery.

questions.question: A prospective trial treated tumors involving the heart with MR-guided RT. What was the objective response rate?
questions.rationale: The objective response rate was 85.7%.
questions.citations: Zheng, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: Updated ASTRO guidelines for rectal cancer recommend what surveillance schedule for patients undergoing non-operative management?

options.text: Proctoscopy and MRI every 3-4 months for 2 years

questions.rationale: Surveillance includes proctoscopy/sigmoidoscopy with digital rectal exam every 3-4 months for the first 2 years... AND pelvic MRI... every 3-6 months for the first 2 years.

questions.question: A study of rectal cancer tumor boost dose found that boosting to 56-60 Gy (vs 50 Gy) significantly improved pCR rates. Which subgroup benefited most?
questions.rationale: Subset analyses indicate cT3-4 tumors uniquely benefit from additional boost doses.

questions.question: In a randomized trial of oxybutynin for hot flashes in men on ADT, what was the safety profile?

options.text: High rate of grade 3 anticholinergic effects

questions.rationale: Furthermore, oxybutynin resulted in no grade 3+ adverse events.

questions.question: The MARIPOSA trial compared amivantamab plus lazertinib vs osimertinib. What was the 3-year overall survival for the combination?
questions.rationale: Three-year overall survival was 60% vs 51%, respectively.

questions.question: A retrospective study of spine SBRT for prostate cancer compared different target volumes. What BED10 was associated with superior control?
questions.rationale: A BED4 ≥100 Gy and BED10 ≥61 Gy were also associated with superior control.

questions.question: A study of retroperitoneal radiation found bowel toxicity risk increased when V45 exceeded what threshold?
questions.rationale: Exceeding bowel V45 >195cc was still associated with an increased risk of toxicity.

questions.question: The DIPPER trial added adjuvant camrelizumab to chemoradiation for high-risk NPC. What toxicity was notably associated with camrelizumab?
questions.rationale: The most common toxicity noted with camrelizumab was something called “reactive capillary endothelial proliferation,” basically a rash of sorts.

questions.question: A study of LINAC energy consumption found which state consumed the most power?
questions.rationale: Energy consumption was less during QA and stand-by mode, but most notably less during treatment delivery [referring to Halcyon vs C-arm difference].

questions.question: The RAVENS trial added Radium-223 to SBRT for oligometastatic prostate cancer. What was the rate of grade 3+ toxicity in the combination arm?
questions.rationale: Radium-223 was associated with a higher rate of grade 3+ treatment related toxicity (17% v 6%).

questions.question: A study using deep learning for p16+ oropharyngeal cancer risk stratification found that high-risk patients (per imaging risk score) benefited from what treatment modification?
questions.rationale: Receipt of concurrent chemo significantly improved disease-free survival for the high-risk cohort with no discernible benefit seen in the low-risk cohort.

questions.question: A Swedish registry study of cT1-2 oropharyngeal cancer found concurrent cisplatin benefited which subgroup?

options.text: Patients <70 with cT2+ primary and multiple ipsilateral nodes

questions.rationale: The only significant advantage of any kind was for patients younger than 70 with multiple ipsilateral nodes... specifically with cT2N2b disease.
questions.citations: Adrian, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A randomized trial compared preoperative vs postoperative SRS for brain metastases. What was the rate of nodular leptomeningeal disease in the preoperative arm?
questions.rationale: The rate of nodular leptomeningeal disease was 1.7% with preop and 4.7% with postop fSRS.
questions.citations: Perlow, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A retrospective study of reirradiation for locoregionally recurrent NSCLC found what 2-year overall survival?
questions.rationale: OS at 2 years was 37.8%.

questions.question: A study of prophylactic magnesium infusions during cisplatin therapy found what impact on acute kidney injury (AKI)?

options.text: Halved the rate of AKI (2.7% vs 5.3%)

questions.rationale: Rates of subsequent AKI were halved in the magnesium cohort (2.7%) versus others (5.3%).

questions.question: A study of flattening filter-free (FFF) vs flattened beams for lung SBRT found what regarding treatment delivery?

options.text: 2.3x faster delivery with no detriment to outcomes

questions.rationale: Delivering treatments 2.3x faster... with no detriment to excellent rates of long term efficacy and toxicity.

questions.question: The COMET trial compared active surveillance vs standard care for low-risk DCIS. What was the 2-year invasive cancer detection rate in the surgery group?
questions.rationale: The primary endpoint of detection of ipsilateral invasive cancer within two years was 5.9% in the surgery group versus 4.2% in the active surveillance group.

questions.question: A study of post-radiation PSMA PET uptake found what optimal timing to predict complete response?
questions.rationale: The optimal time to predict complete response on PSMA PET was 8.6 months.
questions.citations: Onal, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2025

questions.question: A randomized trial evaluated palliative radiation +/- RFA/PVA for painful spine metastases. What was the complete pain response rate?
questions.rationale: There was also no difference in the rate of complete pain control (21% v 17%).

questions.question: A meta-analysis of SRS margins for brain metastases found what regarding local control at 1 year?
questions.rationale: There was no significant difference in local control at 1 year with or without a margin (88.4% v 83%).

questions.question: The MANTLE trial evaluated manual therapy for late dysphagia after H&N radiation. What were the results regarding range of motion?

options.text: Large improvements in cervical and interincisal range of motion

questions.rationale: Large improvements were seen across the board in both objective endpoints of cervical and interincisal range of motion.
questions.citations: McMillan, JAMA Otolaryngol Head Neck Surg 2025

questions.question: A prospective study of palliative radiation given within a month of immunotherapy found what rate of grade 3+ toxicity?
questions.rationale: Measured no associated grade 3+ toxicity.

questions.question: IROCK consensus guidelines for renal cell carcinoma SABR recommend contouring the ipsilateral renal cortex how?
